add.title: LGBTQ rights in Nauru (Wikipedia) — Nauru Regional Processing Centre Rules 2014 gender-identity non-discrimination clause
add.summary: Wikipedia's LGBTQ rights in Nauru article documents the only detention-related gender-identity provision found for Nauru: the Nauru Regional Processing Centre (RPC) Rules 2014, made under the Asylum Seekers (Regional Processing Centre) Act 2012, ban discrimination against any person based on sex or gender, sexual preference or gender identity within the RPC immigration-detention facility. This covers immigration detention, not Nauru's criminal-justice prison system, and concerns non-discrimination rather than placement by birth sex vs identity, special units, or solitary-confinement practice. No documented data was found on where transgender prisoners are housed in Nauru's corrections system, nor any trans-prisoner case or ruling.
